oral_examination.oral_examination: The caries reaches the dentin layer, and the decay is soft and yellowish brown. The reaction of hot and cold diagnosis is the same as that of normal teeth, with pain on probing (-) and percussion (-), no looseness, and no obvious abnormality in the gums.

source_handle: The parents have been informed of the condition, treatment, and cost, and the patient’s family has given informed consent.
